positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "As legislators representing communities across California, we are all firmly committed to solving the urgent crisis of homelessness. Our districts are urban, suburban, and rural, yet each of them is home to a portion of the 161,000 people experiencing homelessness in California on any given night. We must all work together to meet this crisis head on, using our collective political will to marshal historic resources and see through the policy changes to bring all of our neighbors home."
"This bill not only establishes smart long-term investments, but it also focuses resources on more immediate solutions to meet the urgent needs of the current housing crisis."
Voted in favor of HR 8294 "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2023"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: Huffman "Today, U.S. Representative Jared Huffman (D-San Rafael) celebrated the one-year anniversary of the Inflation Reduction Act, landmark legislation which continues to deliver for California families."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 7688 "Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Looking at every policy through the aggrieved "what's in it for me" lens is a race to the bottom. I paid off my student loans and won't benefit from this policy either. But I support the targeted relief it will bring to millions of others who need it."
"We are writing to urge you to act swiftly to extend the current pause on payments and interest for federally-held student loans."

Huffman "COVID-19 emergency relief measures for federal student loans were extended through at least September 30, 2021, including suspension of loan payments, stopped collections on defaulted loans, and a 0% interest rate."
Voted in favor of HR 2547 "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "A transformational anti-corruption and elections reform package to clean up Washington, protect and expand voting rights, restore integrity to government, and put the needs and priorities of the American people ahead of special interests."
Rated 100% by Common Cause

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "I support a much more active federal role in limiting fossil fuel extraction and accelerating the essential transformation to a clean energy economy."
"Increasing investments in energy efficiency and renewable energy sources is a critical tool in the fight against climate change."

"The climate investments and incentives in the Inflation Reduction Act are unlike anything we’ve done before. This will be a major boost to help CA reach its climate goals, and folks across the U.S. are going to see the benefits firsthand."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government allowing permits for drilling on public lands?

evidence.text: "Offshore drilling poses unacceptable risks, and the science and public opinion are clear: we should not put our oceans and fisheries, coastal communities, economies, and planet at risk just to enrich the fossil fuel industry. While Americans are hurting at the pump, Big Oil is hoarding millions of acres of unused leases and capitalizing on the war in Ukraine to gouge customers. Handing over any new leases won't lower prices by a cent -- it will only pad their pockets while fueling the climate crisis"

"Our public lands are some of our nation's and state's greatest gifts -- which is why we must be thoughtful stewards of these special places so that communities can continue to enjoy them and benefit from our rich natural heritage for generations to come. We respectfully and strongly urge you to support inclusion of a public lands package aligned with the House NDAA."

"The climate crisis is happening now. Communities across the country are already facing the effects of climate change, and it's critical we reduce emissions by keeping the world's remaining fossil fuels in the ground," said Representative Huffman. "This legislation is one of the most sensible steps the federal government can take to reduce emissions, protect the public, and avoid the most damaging impacts of climate change."
